text:
```yaml
name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Elixir
        uses: actions/setup-elixir@v3
        with:
          elixir-version: '1.15'
          otp-version: '26.2'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: mix deps.get --only prod

      - name: Run tests
        run: mix test

      - name: Release with git_ops
        uses: jmanhype/github-actions/.github/workflows/git_ops.yml@main
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          config: .github/git_ops.yml
```
